newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai passenger car imports fall sharply in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Thai passenger car imports fall sharply in Sept.

text.p: Thailand's passenger car imports tumbled 121 percent in September to 1,610 units from 3,566 in the same month last year, the Customs Department said on Friday.
The department did not give a reason for the sharp decline in car imports.
Tax collection on car imports in September totalled 341.57 million baht ($13.7 million) compared with 3.57 billion baht in the same month a year ago, the department said.
The imports included 702 cars from Europe, 632 from the United States, 165 from South Korea and 111 from Japan, it said.
America's Chrysler was the most popular import, accounting for all the 632 U.S. cars imported into Thailand in September, it said.
